headline: Reference-free scoring of protein-protein interface similarity in molecular dynamics
label: Protein Interface Quality Assessment
summary: A symmetric, reference-free interface score for MD frames now supports distance-based clustering of protein-protein interface conformations.
synthesis: The dominant thread is quantitative assessment of protein-protein interface geometry. MDQ is a symmetric, reference-free, DockQ-inspired score that compares interfaces across molecular dynamics frames and yields a distance metric for clustering. Its distinguishing feature is that interface similarity is computed without a reference structure, enabling comparison of conformations directly from simulation output. The remaining items are only loosely related: velotest provides a cell-level statistical test of RNA velocity embeddings, addressing embedding fidelity in single-cell data, and the NCF1 preprint links sequence-level conserved blocks and AlphaFold models to severe chronic granulomatous disease mutations. Their data types and outputs differ from MDQ, so results are not directly comparable.
